label: Whatever originates itself does so through its own existentially productive exercise
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, weak self-edge sibling of be90bb15: for every x with a CAUSE_4 self-origin edge CausesOrigin x x, an occurring exercise a borne by x produces x's existence, with produces in the same sense as DEF-NO-EXISTENTIAL-SELF-PRODUCTION (production of the being of the resultant individual, not merely of its coming-to-be). The passage from x's causing its own coming-to-be to an exercise of x producing x's being is this bridge's open content. Nothing is said about origin edges between distinct beings. It does not assert that anything originates itself. Attribution deferred; the application to reality is not established.
